Dynamics of Noether Swarms
Noether Swarms
Binary based assemblies transmit potential via their wave equation, i.e., the spiraling Dirac sphere streams.
The Noether swarm displaces spatial volume, occupying a volume of Euclidean time and space.
The 3D space contained within a Noether swarm is can only be breached if a decay occurs.
The volume displaced by a Noether swarm depends on energy and group velocity.
At velocities far below field speed, Noether swarms thus remain distinct from each other, in a Fermi-Dirac state.
Higgs clusters
The Noether swarms that implement Einstein’s spacetime are extremely well shielded. Gen II is Higgs.
Higgs Noether swarms may be so well shielded that they transmit very little energy.
Higgs Noether swarms become excited by the unshielded energy emanating from standard model assemblies.
This increased energy causes the Higgs Noether swarms to deflate and/or distort. (stretchy-curvy spacetime)
As standard matter becomes denser, the permeating Higgs Noether swarms deflate even more.
The gradient in Noether swarm energy and hence characteristics is the mechanism for gravity.
At extremes in energy standard model matter will react or decay and emerge as assemblies that are more stable at the higher, denser energies.

text: Noether Swarm Geometry and the Lorentz Factor
At high velocity, Noether swarms become more oblate. Do all Noether swarms, pro and anti, left and right, fold the same?
In a standard matter particle? Yes. We are considering the positive quadrant only, given translation.
Therefore, they fold either LLL or RRR. Anti-ness disappears in the boson state because it was based on spin ½.
Standard matter particles are low total energy, but high apparent energy.
In a photon? Photons are bosonic planar. Photons are a pro and anti Noether swarm, contra-rotating at an offset.
Approaching a black hole? At some point all that is left is
Photons which were already planar, but also biplanar.
Does the crossing of the event horizon separate the pro and anti Noether swarms of a photon?
Noether swarms. Getting smaller and more oblate and planar at the event horizon
Interior to the black hole
Everything is planar and photons (contra rotating pro and anti Noether swarm) continue to deflate. Independent Noether swarms are planar and deflate.
Orbitals perturb each other, causing orbit reversals all the way down. Approaching maximum curvature we have ring out until the core locks into one relative microstate, i.e., zero relative entropy.
All have mirror symmetry.
But this is occurring in a plane so CW and CCW are important factors.
Ok so let’s enumerate them LLL LLR LRL LRR RLL RLR RRL RRR (8, essentially it is binary).
Then it is emergence again
Note, when we are talking velocity here, it is usually transverse orbital velocity. Translational velocity is considered independent at this level of analysis)

In an ellipse, the lengths of the semi-major axis ((a)) and the semi-minor axis ((b)) are different.
For an ellipse with semi-major axis ( a ) and semi-minor axis ( b ), there isn’t a simple exact formula for the circumference.
The approximation from Ramanujan is often quite accurate : [ C \approx \pi \left[ 3(a + b) - \sqrt{(3a + b)(a + 3b)} \right] ]
A circle is technically a special case of an ellipse where the two axes are equal (a = b).

All particles are continuously and losslessly exchanging energy with neighbors. Frequently, the neighbors are low apparent energy spacetime aether particles, i.e., gravitons.
When standard matter exchanges energy with spacetime we call that the mass of standard matter.
Mass is based on the root mean squared of the interacting potential.
When standard matter provides RMS mass energy to the spacetime aether, it causes the spacetime energy to rise and the constituent Noether swarms to deflate.
